summary: Allow guarded agents to plan and apply filtered repairs with their literal seat identity

replay.detail: No claim replay or repair planning changes.

compatibility.detail: repair dry-run and conversations status accept optional --as for guarded callers; these remain actorless GETs and print the standard ignored-actor notice. repair apply accepts --as and requires it to equal the literal ST_AGENT/FRACTAL_AGENT seat in an agent environment. The existing repair API remains token-only: this local actor binding does not add actor attribution to repair.applied receipts. Human token-only apply remains supported.

downtime.detail: CLI-only change; no daemon interruption required.

manual.detail: Use st repair dry-run --as "$ST_AGENT" --class revoked-legacy-runtime-start --subject SUBJECT, then st repair apply --as "$ST_AGENT" TOKEN. Existing leading-actor agent-policy guards support both without a Home Manager activation.

recovery.detail: No persistent state or recovery changes.
